content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same issue with Excel 365 as described in section 2.3 of the [document]. The menu for [product_name] doesn't appear in the Add-in tab, even though all related functions are installed for Excel. Does anyone have suggestions? On my tablet running Excel 2016, everything works without problems. [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Please be aware that [product_name] currently supports the following Excel versions (see attachments): - Office Excel 2007, 2010, 2013 (both 32-bit and 64-bit) This limitation likely explains the behavior you're seeing with Excel 365. Best regards, [product_name] support [document]: [url]
Thanks for the response. Luckily, [product_name] works correctly on my Yoga tablet with Office 2016 32-bit.
Will this issue be resolved soon? My entire company now uses Office 365 and I can't access the tool anymore.
I found a related YouTube video in the German section of the forum: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users report problems with the [product_name] menu not appearing or functioning in newer Excel versions, especially Office 365. While the tool remains compatible with older Excel releases, its lack of support for current Office editions limits usability for organizations and individuals who've upgraded, leading to dissatisfaction and workflow disruption.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to be compatible with newer Excel versions, particularly Office 365, and for its menu to appear in the Add-in tab as outlined in the documentation.
